text_en: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord in the days of King Jehoiakim son of Josiah of Judah:
text_cn: 犹大王约史雅的儿子约雅金为王时，上主有话传给耶肋米亚说：

text_en: Go to the house of the Rechabites, and speak with them, and bring them to the house of the Lord , into one of the chambers; then offer them wine to drink.
text_cn: “你到勒加布人家里去，与他们会谈，引他们走进上主殿宇的一间房里，给他们酒喝。”

text_en: So I took Jaazaniah son of Jeremiah son of Habazziniah, and his brothers, and all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites.
text_cn: 于是我带了哈巴漆尼雅的孙子，依尔米雅的儿子雅匝尼雅，和他的兄弟与他所有的儿子，以及勒加布全家，

text_en: I brought them to the house of the Lord into the chamber of the sons of Hanan son of Igdaliah, the man of God, which was near the chamber of the officials, above the chamber of Maaseiah son of Shallum, keeper of the threshold.
text_cn: 到了上主的殿宇，进了天主的人依革达里雅的儿子哈南的儿子们的房间──这间房靠近长官室，正是在看守殿门的沙隆的儿子玛阿色雅的住房上面，

text_en: Then I set before the Rechabites pitchers full of wine, and cups; and I said to them, “Have some wine. ”
text_cn: 将满杯满爵的酒，摆在勒加布的子孙面前，向他们请说：“请喝酒吧！”

text_en: But they answered, “We will drink no wine, for our ancestor Jonadab son of Rechab commanded us, ‘You shall never drink wine, neither you nor your children;
text_cn: 他们答说：“我们不喝酒，因为我们的祖先勒加布的儿子约纳达布曾吩咐我们说：你们和你们的儿子永不可喝酒；

text_en: nor shall you ever build a house, or sow seed; nor shall you plant a vineyard, or even own one; but you shall live in tents all your days, that you may live many days in the land where you reside. ’
text_cn: 也不可建造房屋，不可播种，不可栽植或占有葡萄园，却要终生住在帐幕里，好使你们能长久生活在你们作客的地方。

text_en: We have obeyed the charge of our ancestor Jonadab son of Rechab in all that he commanded us, to drink no wine all our days, ourselves, our wives, our sons, or our daughters,
text_cn: 在我们的祖先勒加布的儿子约纳达布吩咐我们的一切事上，我们全听从了他的话，我们、妻子和儿女，终生不喝酒，

text_en: and not to build houses to live in. We have no vineyard or field or seed;
text_cn: 也不建造房屋居住，也没有葡萄园或田地和播种的事，

text_en: but we have lived in tents, and have obeyed and done all that our ancestor Jonadab commanded us.
text_cn: 只住在帐幕里，全听从并履行我们的祖先约纳达布吩咐的事。

text_en: But when King Nebuchadrezzar of Babylon came up against the land, we said, ‘Come, and let us go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans and the army of the Arameans. ’ That is why we are living in Jerusalem. ”
text_cn: 只在巴比伦王拿步高上来进攻这地时，我们才说：走吧！到耶路撒冷去，躲避加色丁和阿兰军队；从此我们才住在耶路撒冷。”

text_en: Then the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah:
text_cn: 于是有上主的话传给耶肋米亚说：

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: Go and say to the people of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, Can you not learn a lesson and obey my words? says the Lord .
text_cn: “万军的上主，以色列的天主这样说：你去对犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民说：你们不接受教训，听从我的话吗？──上主的断语──

text_en: The command has been carried out that Jonadab son of Rechab gave to his descendants to drink no wine; and they drink none to this day, for they have obeyed their ancestor’s command. But I myself have spoken to you persistently, and you have not obeyed me.
text_cn: 勒加布的儿子约纳达布的话居然有人遵守：他命子孙们不喝酒，他们直到今日就不喝酒，全听从了他们祖先的命令；我不断恳切教训你们，你们却没有听从；

text_en: I have sent to you all my servants the prophets, sending them persistently, saying, “Turn now every one of you from your evil way, and amend your doings, and do not go after other gods to serve them, and then you shall live in the land that I gave to you and your ancestors. ” But you did not incline your ear or obey me.
text_cn: 我给你们派遣──且不断派遣，我所有的仆人先知们，来劝你们各自离弃自己的邪道，改善自己的行为，不再追随事奉外方的神祇，好能住在我赐给你们和你们祖先的地方；你们仍不侧耳听从我。

text_en: The descendants of Jonadab son of Rechab have carried out the command that their ancestor gave them, but this people has not obeyed me.
text_cn: 实在，勒加布的儿子约纳达布的子孙，遵守了他们祖先吩咐的命令；至于这民族，却不听从我。

text_en: Therefore, thus says the Lord , the God of hosts, the God of Israel: I am going to bring on Judah and on all the inhabitants of Jerusalem every disaster that I have pronounced against them; because I have spoken to them and they have not listened, I have called to them and they have not answered.
text_cn: 为此，上主万军的天主，以色列的天主这样说：看，我必给犹大和耶路撒冷所有的居民，招来我对他们所预告的一切灾祸，因为我训谕他们，他们不听；我呼唤他们，他们不答应。”

text_en: But to the house of the Rechabites Jeremiah said: Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: Because you have obeyed the command of your ancestor Jonadab, and kept all his precepts, and done all that he commanded you,
text_cn: 于是耶肋米亚对勒加布人家族说：“万军的上主，以色列的天主这样说：因为你们听从了祖先约纳达布的命令，遵守了他的一切规诫，完全依照他所吩咐的做了；

text_en: therefore thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: Jonadab son of Rechab shall not lack a descendant to stand before me for all time.
text_cn: 为此，万军的上主，以色列的天主这样说：勒加布的儿子约纳达布从此永不会缺少侍立在我面前的人。”
